cohort: Pregnant women who underwent uncomplicated delivery (either normal vaginal delivery or cesarean section) at Yas Hospital Complex in Tehran, Iran, were included in the study.
finding: The mean endometrial thickness at 24 hours postpartum was estimated to be 8.10 ± 3.50 mm in the Iranian population, with a significant inverse correlation observed between endometrial thickness and gestational age.
mod_finding: Endometrial thickness was significantly higher in subjects with normal vaginal delivery (8.65 ± 2.65 mm) compared to those with cesarean section (7.62 ± 3.61 mm).
